title: Meet Debbie: Finding Strength and Support in Tough Times
summary: When tragedy repeatedly struck, Debbie turned to her Papa employee benefit for help surviving life’s most challenging moments.
body_markdown: Debbie is a widow and cancer survivor with a passion for helping others. She ran a call center earlier in life and, more recently, led quality assurance and customer service teams. When her company decided to outsource its call center operations during COVID, Debbie thought she’d retire—until she saw an ad for Papa and applied to be a Papa Pal. After several virtual visits with members, she transitioned to working on Papa’s enrollment team and hasn’t looked back. She recently celebrated her third Papaversary.
